description: The input budget. A document the engine cannot scan inside its budget is refused whole rather than partially redacted, and every refusal message is built from a literal and an integer so no part of the input reaches the message or the stack trace.

builders.unrepresentable: {field: NaN}, a float no JSON encoder can represent.

vectors.name: a surface that is not a registered collection surface

expected.message: Redaction refused the document: it names no registered collection surface.

vectors.name: a document larger than the input budget

expected.message: Redaction refused the document: its size in bytes exceeds the frozen budget of 262144.

vectors.name: a document nested past the depth budget

expected.message: Redaction refused the document: its nesting depth exceeds the frozen budget of 8.

vectors.name: a document with more nodes than the node budget

expected.message: Redaction refused the document: its node count exceeds the frozen budget of 4096.

vectors.name: a value no JSON encoder can represent

expected.message: Redaction refused the document: it is not representable as JSON.
